assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: premium Etail Depot homepage editorial photograph, no typography. Two adults, believable hands and expressions, textured paper and natural skin. No words, logos, signs, payment UI, brand marks, visible card numbers, fake success indicators or collage. One photograph only.
